title: PostgreSQL 18：replication slot保留WAL與磁碟耗盡界線
titleEn: PostgreSQL 18: replication-slot WAL retention and disk exhaustion boundaries
subcategoryTitle: 多租戶、復原相依與可用性邊界
subcategoryTitleEn: Multitenancy, recovery dependencies and availability boundaries
summary: 從合成時間序列追蹤WAL產生、消耗與保留量，估算剩餘容量耗盡時間；把這項容量預測與資料遺失目標分開。
summaryEn: Track WAL generation, consumption and retained volume in synthetic time series. Estimate time to exhaust available headroom while separating that capacity forecast from any recovery-point or data-loss objective.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「盤點WAL保留與空間」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Inventory retained WAL and headroom: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 若只看備援延遲秒數，可能忽略高WAL產量；若刪除slot以解容量，可能失去追趕所需日誌，必須在演練中揭露恢復代價。
在本機模型比較擴容量、恢復消耗與保留上限，保留每案的資料追趕前提；不提供對生產slot的破壞性操作。
備援連線中斷後，replication slot仍保留所需WAL；主站業務尚正常，但保留日誌逐漸吃掉剩餘磁碟，形成復原與可用性的取捨。
optionsEn: Standby lag measured only in seconds can conceal high WAL volume. Removing a slot to relieve capacity can discard the log history needed for catch-up; the exercise must expose that recovery consequence.

Compare more storage, restored consumption and retention caps in the local model. Document catch-up prerequisites for each option without performing destructive operations on production replication slots.

A disconnected standby leaves a replication slot retaining required WAL. The primary still serves requests, but retained logs consume disk headroom, creating a tradeoff between recoverability and continued availability.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。備援連線中斷後，replication slot仍保留所需WAL；主站業務尚正常，但保留日誌逐漸吃掉剩餘磁碟，形成復原與可用性的取捨。 與本階段判準一起判讀：從合成時間序列追蹤WAL產生、消耗與保留量，估算剩餘容量耗盡時間；把這項容量預測與資料遺失目標分開。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. A disconnected standby leaves a replication slot retaining required WAL. The primary still serves requests, but retained logs consume disk headroom, creating a tradeoff between recoverability and continued availability. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Track WAL generation, consumption and retained volume in synthetic time series. Estimate time to exhaust available headroom while separating that capacity forecast from any recovery-point or data-loss objective.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: PostgreSQL replication slot可避免必要WAL被過早回收，也可能保留到填滿磁碟；設定保留上限會改變失聯備援是否仍能追上，不是免費保證。
knowledge.textEn: PostgreSQL replication slots can prevent needed WAL from being recycled, but retention can fill storage. A retention cap changes whether a disconnected standby can catch up; it is not a cost-free guarantee.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: PostgreSQL replication slot可避免必要WAL被過早回收，也可能保留到填滿磁碟；設定保留上限會改變失聯備援是否仍能追上，不是免費保證。
knowledge.textEn: PostgreSQL replication slots can prevent needed WAL from being recycled, but retention can fill storage. A retention cap changes whether a disconnected standby can catch up; it is not a cost-free guarantee.

stages.title: 盤點WAL保留與空間
stages.description: 備援連線中斷後，replication slot仍保留所需WAL；主站業務尚正常，但保留日誌逐漸吃掉剩餘磁碟，形成復原與可用性的取捨。 從合成時間序列追蹤WAL產生、消耗與保留量，估算剩餘容量耗盡時間；把這項容量預測與資料遺失目標分開。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 每小時列生成位元組、消耗位元組與保留差，磁碟空間從已扣其他用途的120GB開始。當消耗超過可用積壓加新生成量時截於可消耗量，不能讓保留WAL變負或憑空產生空間。
stages.descriptionEn: A disconnected standby leaves a replication slot retaining required WAL. The primary still serves requests, but retained logs consume disk headroom, creating a tradeoff between recoverability and continued availability. Track WAL generation, consumption and retained volume in synthetic time series. Estimate time to exhaust available headroom while separating that capacity forecast from any recovery-point or data-loss objective. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. For each hour list generated bytes, consumed bytes and retained balance, starting with 120 GB of headroom after other uses. Cap consumption at available backlog plus new generation; retained WAL cannot become negative or create fictional free space simply because an assumed consumer rate exceeds available data.
